tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: white, per the style guide. Dark: a blue-black drawn from the logo's void.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary panels, table stripes, the Card fill, form field backgrounds.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only (fails 3:1, so never the only edge of a control).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; 3.2:1+ on surface and surface-alt in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text (#130F25 from the style guide), on surface and surface-alt. 18.7:1 light, 16.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, on surface and surface-alt (6.3:1+ light, 7.5:1+ dark).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand Blue #4379F3, kept exact in both themes. Use for H1–H3, icons and brand fills only. 3.99:1 on white passes for large text (24px+, or 19px+ bold) and marks, so the 4.5:1 warning is expected; set body-size blue text in blue-text. 4.86:1 on the dark surface.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Brand Red #ED5634, kept exact in both themes. Use for emphasis marks, highlights and hover on large heading links only. 3.51:1 on white passes for large text and marks, so the 4.5:1 warning is expected; set body-size red text in red-text. 5.52:1 on the dark surface.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Links and any blue text at body size; the primary button fill. A darker (light) / lighter (dark) step of Brand Blue that reaches 5:1 on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red text at body size: link hover, error messages, the danger Alert. 5.4:1 on white, 4.8:1 on danger-soft; 7.5:1+ dark.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon color on a blue-text or red-text fill (primary button). White in light, the dark surface in dark.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind blue-text: the info Alert, selected rows.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind red-text: the danger Alert, invalid field background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state, as text, icon or border, on surface or success-soft. A teal from the logo that leans toward blue, so it never relies on telling red from green.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success text: the success Alert.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks and inline code, in both themes (style guide: dark code view).

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Text on code-bg (12.9:1).

tokens.name: pixel-mint
tokens.usage: Logo color. Illustration, cover art and brand moments only; never text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: pixel-teal
tokens.usage: Logo color. Illustration and decorative pixel grids; never text on light surfaces (fails contrast).

tokens.name: pixel-magenta
tokens.usage: Logo color, the glitch red. Illustration only; Brand Red (red) is the UI accent.

tokens.name: pixel-void
tokens.usage: Logo color, the near-black behind the skull. Dark brand panels, the cover's deep block.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of blue-text.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover and the primary button hover: blue turns red, as in the original style guide.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Raleway, colored blue. Raleway draws old-style figures by default; headings set font-variant-numeric: lining-nums so numbers sit on the baseline.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Subsections and card titles. 20px = 1.25rem; bold, so Brand Blue still clears 3:1.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Nunito Sans for body and every incidental: labels, captions, buttons, inputs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We design and build fast, accessible sites that search engines and AI answers can read.
styles.usage: Default UI and short copy. 16px = 1rem, line-height 1.2 as specified.

styles.name: body-long
styles.sample: Long-form articles and case studies read easier with more air between lines.
styles.usage: Recommended addition: articles, docs and anything over three lines. Same size as body, line-height 1.5.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, metadata, helper text under fields. 0.875rem.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and tags. Set text-transform: uppercase. 0.75rem.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Roboto Mono for code blocks, inline code and Markdown views (from the 2024 style guide).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks: code-ink on code-bg, 16px padding, radius-sm.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code inside body text: 4px padding, radius-sm.

spacing.note: 4px base. 16px is the default inset (container gutter, code block padding).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inline code padding, icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; button side padding pairs with space-4.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Container gutter, card and code block padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on wide screens.

radius.note: Mostly square: a pixel brand. 4px is the house radius from the style guide.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Pixel art, cover blocks, full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, code blocks, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and alerts.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; center with margin-inline auto and pad with space-4.

shadow.note: Flat by default; one elevation and the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised cards and menus.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px surface gap, then 2px of solid blue-text (5:1+). Apply as box-shadow on :focus-visible.
